# Mina Textile Industries (MTI)

> ISO 9001:2015 certified precision engineering and industrial casting manufacturer, founded in 1964, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. MTI manufactures precision castings, power transmission products (pulleys, couplings, flywheels), manifolds, and custom-machined, ready-to-install components, 1 KG to 8,000 KG per piece, for OEMs in India and export markets.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1964
- Headquarters: Block No. 4, New Shalkhata, Gujarat Ginning Mill Compound, Outside Premdarwaja, Ahmedabad – 380016, Gujarat, India
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015 (since 2015)
- Weight range: 1 KG to 8,000 KG per piece
- Standards supported: IS, ASME, EN
- Leadership: Atul V. Salot (Chairman), Milan V. Salot (Vice Chairman)
- Notable clients: Ingersoll Rand, Fenner India, Dresser Rand, Thermax India, PIX Transmission, Gardner Denver, Modern Insulators, McNally Sayaji Engineering, Amman Apollo India, Solitaire Machine Tools
- Contact: +91 79 22123506, minatext_1029@yahoo.co.in
- Registrations: GST 24AANFM5019LIZ1, Udyam UDYAM-GJ-01-0030316
